messages:
jess: Heads up — we had a pod stuck Pending in eu-west-1 trying to schedule onto gpu-spot nodepool. Looks like cluster-autoscaler didn't scale because of taint mismatch. Anyone seen this pattern?
lia: ugh yeah. we recently tightened nodepool taints for isolation (gpu=true:NoSchedule) and some jobs don't set tolerations.
samir: do we prefer changing workloads or adding a fallback untainted spot pool? cost vs safety tradeoff.
marco: adding an untainted fallback defeats isolation guarantees for tenant workloads. but we could make a tiny buffer pool with tolerations and nodeSelector + nodeAffinity for trusted namespaces.
jess: idea: small guaranteed on-demand gpu pool (min=1, max=2) for warm capacity + larger spot pool with taint for preemptible jobs. autoscaler config should prefer scaling on-demand if pod requests strict tolerations.
lia: agree. also cluster-autoscaler flags we use need max-empty-bulk-delete and scale-down-delay to avoid churn with short-lived jobs. current helm values set scaleDownDelay=10m which is too aggressive for GPU start time.
samir: here's a minimal values.yaml snippet I tried:```yaml
clusterAutoscaler:
  enabled: true
  awsAutoDiscovery:
    resourceDiscovery: "asg:tag=k8s.io/cluster-autoscaler/enabled"
  expander: "least-waste"
  scaleDownDelay: 30m
  nodeGroups:
    - name: gpu-ondemand
      minSize: 1
      maxSize: 4
      instanceType: p3.2xlarge
    - name: gpu-spot
      minSize: 0
      maxSize: 20
      instanceType: p3.2xlarge
      taints: ["gpu=true:NoSchedule"]
```
marco: I think "least-waste" is ok, but for GPUs we might want expander=priority with weights: prefer ondemand when pods require toleration X. cluster-autoscaler can use node-group priority via labels.
anika: also remember ip exhaustion in eu-west-1 last week — we hit CNI pod IP quota when the autoscaler spun up too many nodes concurrently. need concurrency throttle and pre-provisioning windows.
jess: good call. for Terraform, we should add a service that keeps a 2-min buffer of nodes in Pending state? or simpler: use warm nodes (minSize>0) in on-demand pool.
lia: Terraform snippet we can add for node pool autoscaling policy:```hcl
resource "aws_autoscaling_group" "gpu_spot" {
  name = "gpu-spot-asg"
  min_size = 0
  max_size = 20
  mixed_instances_policy { /* ... */ }
  tag { key = "k8s.io/cluster-autoscaler/enabled" value = "true" propagate_at_launch = true }
}
resource "aws_autoscaling_group" "gpu_ondemand" {
  name = "gpu-ondemand-asg"
  min_size = 1
  max_size = 4
  tag { key = "k8s.io/cluster-autoscaler/enabled" value = "true" propagate_at_launch = true }
}
```
samir: can we teach the scheduler to prefer GPU nodes with nodeAffinity for workloads that tolerate spot? that way pods that can handle preemption go to spot pool automatically.
marco: yes: add nodeAffinity requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution with preferredDuringScheduling for spot-tolerant jobs and nodeSelector terms for labels like gpu-preemptible=true.
anika: another ops note — set cloudProvider flags for scale-up-delay and unneeded-time to > 8m to avoid scaling up/down noise while images are pulling. GPU nodes take longer to initialize.
jess: ops, cost: if we keep 1 on-demand always, estimate +$X/month. but reduces failed deploys and autoscaler thrash. worth for prod namespaces.
lia: we should also add alerts: high pending GPU pods > 5 for >5m, and node creation failures in ASG >3 in 15m. infra-bot can post to #incidents.
infra-bot: [deploy-bot] cluster-autoscaler helm chart upgraded on staging at 2026-02-10T09:12Z (chart v1.13.0). No errors on upgrade.
samir: can someone open a PR with: terraform for two ASGs (ondemand + spot), helm values for CA with scaleDownDelay=30m, and add node labels/taints docs? I can review.
marco: I'll sketch the PR and include migration notes for namespaces that lacked tolerations. also include a script to patch existing deployments with tolerations for gpu=true for approved namespaces.
jess: thanks. quick action items: 1) PR with terraform + helm values 2) alert rules 3) patch script for tolerations 4) cost delta estimate. assigning to @marco and @samir. :thumbsup:
lia: tagging @anika for CNI IP quota checks in eu-west-1 and to validate max node concurrency.
anika: on it. I'll run a simulation tomorrow and post numbers.
jess: closing loop — if infra-bot sees >3 Pending GPU pods in 10m, post to #eng-infra and create a PagerDuty incident for on-call.
